geometry_definition: candidate geometry_status=='ok', at least four consensus nodes, connection available; no target Q/reference quantity enters selection
source_incomplete_prefix: ineligible at that k; all source views must have valid B8L2; no interpolation
main_choices: B8L2 source; same choices evaluated by D10
time_contract: only pools entirely new-origin with known same-semantics source_new_total_seconds at every full-pool source/target; other time outputs missing
time_meaning: reported annotation activity, not queue/completion delivery time or money
history_budgets: m=1 plus every m>N/2; no pooling actual m in main result
weights: repeated splits/paths within target and m, then target equal, group equal within building, building equal
full_pool: all workers common to the declared supported replay panel, not every available annotator on each image
online_rule: first k>=5 with same selected node count at three consecutive complete target prefix outputs; fallback common-pool endpoint; no reference or source history
source_cost: full common pool on each historical image; acquired annotations reused for all permutations; reference construction and scoring labor not recorded and excluded, not assumed zero
dot_comparison: same full-pool all-attempt and common-complete supports; k>=1 versus k>=3 separated
decisions_export: whole groups, maximum actual history, 8 named policies; other cases exactly reproducible from code+frozen node table
original_script_identity: current reconstruction/new analysis, not recovered Pro original
identity: v2.1 downstream replay of original exact team/order/source-budget design
